items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: On clarinet we had Bob McCracken... The group was composed of Mr. Blakeney on trumpet... Bob McCracken, clarinet

ctx.x: Of course that was the legendary Montudie Garland.
That's right. On clarinet we had Bob McCracken,
a white guy; and on trombone we had Warren Smith, who used to be with the Bobcats.
